# Coverage Depth

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CoverageDepth`](gmeow-CoverageDepth.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CoverageDepth>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/evidence`](../../slices/evidence.md)

The depth of coverage a source provides about its subject — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Distinguishes significant in-depth treatment from passing mention or routine filing. This axis is orthogonal to source tier and independence.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CoverageDepth`](gmeow-CoverageDepth.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
